limitations: CAMS archived model output and ERA5 reanalysis, not station observations.
Historical periods are not prospective; configurations were informed by previously consumed later archive diagnostics.
Hourly risk support is correlated and is not independent pollution episodes.
The threshold-selection period was label-adaptively allocated by earliest support; its metrics are development results, not an independent holdout.
Locked evaluation labels were not used for selecting model or threshold.
Target-hour recorded weather is oracle weather, not a deployed weather forecast.
No human review, field evidence, billed cost measurement, or safety/medical qualification is established.
Candidate bundle is research-only; no serving artifact was changed.
